title: End-to-End Cell Detection via Instance-aware Graph Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.15354v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate cell detection and classification are crucial for pathological analysis, directly affecting diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning. To capture complex cellular interactions beyond visual appearance within the tumor microenvironment, several approaches have employed graph neural networks to model spatial and relational patterns among cell nuclei, yielding promising results. However, these methods typically adopt a two-stage paradigm of visual extraction followed by relational modeling, which necessitates separate tuning for each stage, thereby increasing pipeline complexity and hindering end-to-end joint optimization. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end framework for cell detection and classification that jointly models patch-level visual representations and instance-level interactions, which incorporates a dynamic graph construction module and an instance-aware graph network. translated_title: 基于实例感知图建模的端到端细胞检测
translated_abstract: 准确的细胞检测与分类对病理分析至关重要，直接影响诊断准确性和治疗方案的制定。为了捕捉肿瘤微环境中超越视觉外观的复杂细胞相互作用，一些方法已经采用图神经网络来建模细胞核之间的空间和关系模式，并取得了可喜的成果。然而，这些方法通常采用视觉提取后接关系建模的两阶段范式，需要对每个阶段分别进行调整，从而增加了流程的复杂性，并阻碍了端到端的联合优化。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于细胞检测与分类的端到端框架，该框架联合建模补丁级视觉表示和实例级交互，其中包含一个动态图构建模块和一个实例感知图网络。具体来说，图构建模块……
tldr: 提出了一种结合动态图构建模块与实例感知图网络的端到端细胞检测与分类框架，联合建模补丁级视觉表示和实例级交互，克服了传统两阶段范式的复杂性和优化难题。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end cell detection and classification framework is proposed that jointly models patch-level visual representations and instance-level interactions through a dynamic graph construction module and an instance-aware graph network, overcoming the complexity and optimization challenges of traditional two-stage paradigms.
